parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.

When calling this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the credential, see Enterprise access credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, use crop_token=value instead

在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
